slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Dusron ki speed dekhkar apni progress ko small mat samjho.
Tum logon ke highlights ko apne behind-the-scenes se compare kar rahe ho.
Resources, timing aur responsibilities sabki different hoti hain.
Aaj ka target kal wale version se better hona hai, kisi aur se nahi.
Har week teen small improvements likho aur unhe honestly celebrate karo.
Apna pace respect karo. Tum late nahi ho—tum apne route par ho.

caption:
Comparison tumhari progress ko invisible bana deta hai.

Aaj apni journey dekho—tum kal se better ho ya nahi, bas itna matter karta hai.
